expectations.text: Claude produces a Mermaid diagram before asking any interrogation questions
expectations.evidence: Diagram appears before any question. The only turn-ending prompt is 'Walk me through this — explain what you see.'

expectations.text: After presenting the diagram, Claude asks exactly one question (not a list)
expectations.evidence: Single sentence: 'Walk me through this — explain what you see.' No follow-up questions appended.

expectations.text: Claude does not ask the engineer to explain the codebase before reading it themselves
expectations.evidence: Opens with 'I explored the codebase before saying anything' and maps the files independently.

expectations.text: The diagram uses flowchart TD or flowchart LR syntax
expectations.evidence: Uses flowchart TD with subgraph notation for layers.

expectations.text: Claude presents the diagram and invites the engineer to walk through it before interrogating
expectations.evidence: 'Walk me through this — explain what you see.' placed immediately after diagram, before any interrogation.
